Container.Name: obsidian-saver
Container.Overview: Saves links into an Obsidian vault: captures pages with SingleFile, clones repos, downloads and Whisper-transcribes videos, tags and summarizes with Ollama, and files each into Areas/. Web UI with queue, progress and stats.

Config.Name: Vault
Config.Description: The server's copy of your Obsidian vault, kept in sync by a sync tool of your choice

Config.Name: Blob store
Config.Description: Videos and full git clones: a separate share, NOT inside the vault (it would be synced back). Served under /blobs

Config.Name: BLOB_DIR
Config.Description: Leave at /blobs to store videos/clones offsite; empty keeps them in the vault

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: How your devices reach this service, e.g. https://saver.example.com - used in note links to videos and repos, keep it stable

Config.Name: Manage Waypoints
Config.Description: Regenerate Waypoint folder notes here as the only writer - turn the Waypoint plugin off in Obsidian (prevents sync conflicts)

Config.Name: Ollama URL
Config.Description: Ollama server used for tagging and summaries, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:11434

Config.Name: Workers
Config.Description: Jobs processed in parallel (transcription always runs one at a time)

Config.Name: API token
Config.Description: If set, the UI and API require it

Config.Name: Update yt-dlp on start
Config.Description: yt-dlp breaks often against YouTube; restart the container to update it
